posts.title: BPF Token Delegation
posts.description: What Is a BPF Token? The BPF Token prevents a process from gaining full root-level access to execute BPF code. The kernel hands out a BPF Token as a special permission slip to run BPF code. Only the privileged process can provide these specific BPF permissions, like loading, creating maps, etc to an unprivileged one to execute code or create maps, etc. Kernel version 6.9 introduced the BPF Token.
